claims.statement: For every genuine Boolean f on disjoint uniform cubes with X-degree at most d, the conditional spectral entropy may be paid by the averaged mixed anchored-tail complexity B(q)=min{H_{1/2}(q), h2(epsilon)+epsilon H_{1/2}(tail)}. This yields the phase-energy inequality in CONDITIONAL_PHASE_THEOREM.tex. On every k-bit one-point defect the tail expression is exact Shannon entropy and at most 4I, while a fixed cap excludes repeated arbitrary positive-entropy tensor factors.
claims.quantifiers: All finite disjoint uniform Boolean cubes X,Y; every genuine Boolean f; integer d>=1; all positive spectral fibers; any maximum-mass anchor.
supersedes: B07-A034-RENYI-FIBER-v1 as the strongest current A034 completion
scope_exclusions: No claim for correlated physical inputs
